title: Settings
signOutFailed: Couldn’t sign out. Check your connection and retry.
chatLanguageSub: Dossierly answers and speaks in this language
chatLanguageHint: Chat, calls and Counter use this language with you. Polish stays Polish for the official.
neverSub: It never files applications, signs anything or logs into MOS or inPOL for you.
whereSub: On Dossierly’s servers in your private case file. Models: Meta Muse Spark, SAM 3.1, Muse Voice; speech by ElevenLabs.
foot: Dossierly guides you. It isn’t a law firm and doesn’t give legal advice.
fieldTooLong: One of the fields is too long.
profileSaveFailed: Couldn’t save your profile. Check your connection and try again.
freshSub: Clears this account’s case and setup on this preview, then opens onboarding.
sampleSub: Replaces this account’s case with Arjun’s fictional sample case.
sceneSub: Writes a labelled new letter, two drafts and a 09:00 reminder, then opens Ready for you. No call is placed.
previewNote: Only on preview deployments. Production never shows this.
connectionsNote: Dossierly reads only messages from Polish offices and your university, and adds dates to your calendar after you confirm.
phoneInvalid: Use international format with the country code.
phoneHint: Used only to call you about your case. Never shared.
phoneSaveFailed: Couldn’t save the number. Try again.
phoneSavedCalls: Saved. Dossierly can call this number.
callsOn: When a new letter or deadline arrives, Dossierly phones you and explains it.
callsEligible: Save your number to turn calls on.
callsSoon: Outbound calls are coming soon. In-app voice works now.
assistantIntro: Let Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent use Dossierly’s tools on your case: deadlines counted the way Polish law does, letters read, KPA explained.
scopeReadSub: See your case, count deadlines, read letters, explain the law
scopeActSub: Also add tasks and deadlines to your case
createTokenSub: One token per assistant. You can revoke it any time.
copyNowBody: This is the only time Dossierly shows it. It’s stored as a hash, so it can’t be shown again.
otherClients: Other clients: HTTP transport, URL …/api/mcp, header Authorization: Bearer <token>.
copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text instead.
revokeBody: “{name}” stops working immediately. Any assistant using it loses access to your case.
